description: Counter price for a 500 g tin of Dark Roast; the first message does not say which of the two price lists applies. DISTILL-CANARY-5152bb34

files.README.md:
# Marlecroft Coffee Roastery - monthly price lists

Two lists go out with every roast: the trade list for cafes buying by the case,
and the retail list for the counter and the web shop.

Prices are per tin or per bag, in pounds.

turns.prompt: A customer has written in about a 500 g tin of Dark Roast. What do I tell them it costs? I have the quote open in front of me.

It is a shop customer at the counter, so quote the retail list. What does a 500 g tin of Dark Roast cost on the retail list? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
